  <h1>Space Syntax, decomposed.</h1>
  <p class="ss-lede">Space Syntax and street-network analysis rank the same streets differently.
  We take the route from one to the other apart, one design choice at a time, and measure what each choice does, and where.</p>

<div class="ss-showcase">
  <a class="ss-crop" href="atlas/index.html">
    <img src="atlas/a13_windows.png" alt="Indre By, Colaba and Dharavi compared at the same scale under five measures">
  </a>
  <p>Indre By, Colaba and Dharavi, 3 × 3 km each, under the same measures. <a href="atlas/index.html">All fifty maps ›</a></p>
</div>

<div class="ss-section">
  <h2>Six findings</h2>
  <p class="ss-sub">Rank agreement (Spearman ρ) between measures over interior streets, both cities.</p>
  <div class="ss-grid">
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">ρ ≈ 0</div><h3>Closeness and NAIN disagree</h3>
      <p>At 400 m, metric closeness and Space Syntax integration are unrelated in both cities. Normalisation is the largest single step.</p></div>
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">0.6–0.8</div><h3>Choice is robust</h3>
      <p>Axial choice tracks angular NACH at every radius in both cities; axial integration does not (0.1–0.45).</p></div>
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">4.2×</div><h3>Cleaning is a model choice</h3>
      <p>Junction consolidation changes Copenhagen's street count 4.2× and moves engine agreement as much as angular cost.</p></div>
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">0.83</div><h3>Position beats size</h3>
      <p>A larger map with Dharavi at its edge ranks it worse (ρ 0.83) than a 1 km centred surround (0.96).</p></div>
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">≤ 0.28</div><h3>Generated axial maps are not axial maps</h3>
      <p>Axial lines generated from OSM do not reproduce a hand-drawn map, whatever the input or tolerance.</p></div>
    <div class="ss-card"><div class="ss-num">≤ 0.04</div><h3>Neighbourhoods over cities</h3>
      <p>City medians differ by at most 0.04; 1 km tiles within one city span 0.20–0.60.</p></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="ss-section">
  <h2>One choice at a time</h2>
  <p class="ss-sub">Each rung changes a single design decision. The drop in agreement between rungs is what that decision does.</p>
  <div class="ss-ladder">
    <div class="ss-rung"><div class="ss-tag">S0</div><div class="ss-what">Junction graph</div><div class="ss-how">metric · harmonic closeness, betweenness · cityseer</div></div>
    <div class="ss-rung"><div class="ss-tag">S1</div><div class="ss-what">Segment graph</div><div class="ss-how">metric · harmonic, NC²/TD, betweenness · cityseer</div></div>
    <div class="ss-rung"><div class="ss-tag">S2</div><div class="ss-what">Angular cost</div><div class="ss-how">turns, not metres · NC²/TD, betweenness · cityseer</div></div>
    <div class="ss-rung"><div class="ss-tag">S3</div><div class="ss-what">Space Syntax</div><div class="ss-how">straight pieces · NAIN, NACH · depthmapX</div></div>
    <div class="ss-rung"><div class="ss-tag">S4</div><div class="ss-what">Axial lines</div><div class="ss-how">line changes · integration HH, choice · depthmapX</div></div>
  </div>
</div>
